observations: Three photos show a pair of car headlights lying on a dirty ground.
The headlights have a silver housing with two circular lenses each — one larger, one smaller — and a clear lens cover.
The design is consistent with early 2000s luxury SUVs, possibly Porsche Cayenne.
No visible brand or model markings on the headlights themselves in any photo.
The headlights appear to be in used condition with some dirt and minor surface scratches.
No wiring harnesses, bulbs, or mounting brackets are visible in the photos.
The seller claims they are for a 2006 Porsche Cayenne, but no proof is visible in the images.

claims.claim: Set of full light Porsche Cayenne 2006
claims.evidence: No visible brand or model markings on the headlights in any photo. The design is consistent with early Cayenne models, but not confirmable from images alone.

response.reason: The headlights cannot be confirmed as being for a 2006 Porsche Cayenne from the current photos. Their functionality and completeness are also unverified. Without proof of model compatibility and working condition, a reliable price cannot be assigned.
